title: @chauffeur_afni
description: Automated QC snapshots generator in AFNI

ulay.description: Name of underlay dataset (required); can be 3D or 4D set
ulay.title: Underlay dataset

mode_4D.description: For each viewing plane, one slice is selected across all volumes in a 4D dataset
mode_4D.title: 4D mode

func_range.description: Specify upper value of the overlay dataset to be matched to top of colorbar (default: 98%ile non-zero value of dataset)
func_range.title: Functional range

opacity.description: Enter an opacity factor for the overlay (0-9, with 9 being opaque)
opacity.title: Overlay opacity

montx.description: Number of image panels in a row (default: 3)
montx.title: Montage X

monty.description: Number of image panels in a column (default: 3)
monty.title: Montage Y

montgap.description: Number of pixels as gap between image panels (default: 0)
montgap.title: Montage gap

no_clean.description: Do not remove the temporary directory of copied/intermediate files
no_clean.title: No clean

do_clean.description: Remove the temporary directory of copied/intermediate files
do_clean.title: Do clean
